svg.title: Omanotch
svg.desc: Animated diagram of Omanotch. A MacBook runs Omarchy full screen in a VM; the strip beside the camera notch is black and unused, and Omarchy's Rose Pine Dawn top bar sits inside the VM below it. Above the laptop floats an empty invisible monitor that belongs to the VM; Omarchy renders the same bar into it. The Omanotch Mac app streams the changed pixels down into the black strip until the bar fills it, the bar inside the VM disappears and the windows grow to full height. A workspace switch shows later updates arriving as small diffs. A cursor clicks the clock in the strip, the click travels back through Omanotch to the VM, and a calendar panel drops open below the clock.
